_comment: Seed manifest for national/congressional legislative votes (Policy & Governance Votes). Populated for measures in the Nov 16–Dec 31, 2026 window (119th Congress), aligned to published feed campaigns 93005–93016.

campaigns.title: Providing for consideration of H.R. 3495 and H.R. 5267 (rule)

campaigns.bounty_description: Open-ended Policy & Governance Vote (litmus test) for H. Res. 1665. Bounty benefits verified 501(c)(3)/public-benefit entities aligned to campaign impact (labor/economic fairness and civic participation), finalized per campaign governance and verification.
